name: Kentai 003
source:
As a result of the last training program, she is now a paizuri slave.
She is your navigator in this game.

She'll help you show Test Subject 004 how it's done. You can demonstrate what a fully realized paizuri slave can do with a "Titjob Display".

She knows no other pleasure than providing her chest for use, and she'll titillate her "kouhai" with tempting words. She'll keep working until 004 realizes the true happiness of living as a paizuri slave.
